title: Treasury Admits Insolvency. Bitcoin Already Knew.
script_summary:
# ORACLE BRIEF

The US Treasury just admitted insolvency in its own financial statements — 47 trillion in unfunded liabilities. Bitcoin already priced this in.

While the government's books don't balance, MicroStrategy just executed the largest single-day Bitcoin acquisition in the asset's history — over a billion dollars pulled off exchange supply in one session. Post-halving, miner issuance is down fifty percent. These coins aren't coming back to market.
